policy: Owner decision 2 (2026-10-22): keep BT identity, locations and mount layout; convert armour, heat, speed, jump and economy through this versioned profile; keep the raw BT values beside every converted value.

armor._note: MC2 armour per location = round(tabletop armour * scale). Stock MC2 mechs carry roughly 0.56-0.6 of tabletop armour (Mad Cat 130 vs ~230).

structure._note: MC2 internal structure = tabletop internal structure (stock Mad Cat 75t matches the tabletop table exactly).

heat._note: MC2 Heat Index = base + per_sink * (engine sinks + installed sinks). Mad Cat analogue: 61.

speed._note: MC2 speed classes (MaxRunSpeed) and their displayed km/h. Run MP = ceil(1.5 * walk MP); walk MP = MaxWalkDistance / 30 m. Pick the class whose display speed is nearest.

economy._note: MC2 ChassisC-Bills = BT chassis cost / divisor (Archer 6.8M -> ~48.6k, stock Mad Cat 47.75k).

payload._note: Package chassis enforce the mass budget the stock logistics weight check skipped. payload = MC2 mass of the reference (first) variant's mapped equipment + slack; empty_mass = tonnage - payload. Slack = floor(slack_per_ton * tonnage) lets a player trade weapons for armour plates without breaking the stock loadout.

jump._note: MC2 jump range is fixed (5) for any jump-capable mech; BT jet counts are kept raw.
